Game Overview

At its heart, Hop-Hop is a cats game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Hop-Hop doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Hop-Hop?

Hop-Hop is a free cats game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Hop-Hop free to play?

Yes, Hop-Hop is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
